clariti_edc

Source: R/data.R
clariti_edc.Rd

NACCADRC UDS Electronic Data Capture (EDC) dataset. The data is sourced from the file(s) investigator_clariti_edc_naccDEV.csv.

Usage

data(clariti_edc)

Format

A data frame with 606 rows and 56 variables:

NACCADC

ADC at which participant was seen (100 –9999)

NACCID

Participant ID
